newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar barely moves, market awaits NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar barely moves, market awaits NY.

text.p: Spot August was the only position traded on London's white sugar futures market on Thursday morning as traders held back before the New York market opening.
By 1110 GMT August was up just 10 cents at $318.00 after moving in a range of $1.40. Volume was 132 lots.
Traders reported little in the way of fresh fundamental news although continued to look for news of white sugar imports into Russia, in addition to the hefty raws shipments into the Black Sea region.

Technical analysts said August would have to edge higher and test $319 or $320 before a downward correction was likely to occur. The position is seen as well supported at $316.60, Thursday's intraday low.
The Paris market was extremely quiet with just nine lots of the August contract on the board. The position was 30 cents weaker at $318.00. --Jeremy Smith, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8064
